links.outcome: GPT-4o diagnostic accuracy grading diabetic retinopathy from fundus photographs versus FDA-approved AI
links.effect: GPT-4o sensitivity 47.7% and specificity 73.8%, significantly lower than FDA-approved AI systems; strong bias toward classifying images as no DR; mild DR accuracy 49.8% in binary tasks.
links.quote: When compared to FDA-approved AI systems, GPT-4o's sensitivity (47.7%) and specificity (73.8%) were significantly lower.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering variants (8 prompts) to improve multimodal LLM diagnostic accuracy on fundus images

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4o on a benchmark dataset of fundus photographs (EyePACS) using various prompt variations, measuring model performance only without testing a deployment practice.
